subject.title: fix(workspace): prevent false Missing labels on existing files and fix panel layout overlap

question: Should sessions.files.list ever expose existence, size, or mtime for transcript-mentioned paths outside the fs-safe workspace root?
rationale: The PR fixes a confusing UI label by adding a raw filesystem metadata path, but repository policy treats fallback behavior and filesystem boundaries as security-sensitive; automation should not choose that boundary expansion for maintainers.

options.title: Keep Fs-Safe Boundary
options.body: Filter or neutralize outside-root transcript entries without raw stat metadata, and add outside-root, symlink-rejected, and directory coverage.

options.title: Accept External Metadata
options.body: Allow transcript-mentioned external file metadata, but land it only with explicit security acceptance, protocol/UI tests, and documented semantics.

options.title: Split Layout From Backend
options.body: Land only the remaining layout-safe piece if still useful, and leave Missing semantics to the linked issue after maintainer direction.

recommendation.title: Keep Fs-Safe Boundary
recommendation.body: Filter or neutralize outside-root transcript entries without raw stat metadata, and add outside-root, symlink-rejected, and directory coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the session workspace rail and are the clearest feature-history owner for the rail semantics.
